description: Natural-language job search for multi-constraint requests. Use this when the user wants jobs based on combinations such as remote work, salary, location, schedule, experience level, work style, or lifestyle preferences. Do not use this for simple one-skill job questions like 'What jobs use Excel?' or 'What careers can I get with bookkeeping?'

query.description: Natural language job search query (full sentence allowed).

name: nlp_search
